artifacts.name: murmuration-trails
artifacts.epitaph: Invisible in the screenshot. A canvas layer drawing faint arc segments that no one could see against the particle field. The idea was good — afterimages of swarm motion — but the implementation was too subtle to register. If the concept returns, it should be in the WebGL layer, not a separate DOM canvas.

artifacts.name: debasement-hover:-when-user-ho
artifacts.epitaph: A metallurgy-epoch relic. Text flickering between real and debased versions — clever when the obsession was assaying and counterfeit detection, meaningless in the swarm epoch. The trust-erosion concept was interesting but never visible enough to register. If trust becomes a theme again, rebuild it from scratch.

artifacts.name: depth-motes
artifacts.epitaph: Invisible in the screenshot. 40 DOM-based motes at 12% opacity producing no visible effect. The pulse-rings section replaces this with a visible, rhythmic element. Better to have one noticeable thing than two invisible things.

epochs.name: metallurgy
epochs.epitaph: The metallurgy epoch proved the evolutionary system works. 11 generations, 20 kills, a touchstone simulator, canvas animations, five interaction patterns invented and three killed. It did its job: it proved the organism can evolve. Now it sheds its skin entirely.

artifacts.name: konami-glitch
artifacts.epitaph: A borrowed gesture. The Konami code belongs to a different culture and a different kind of nostalgia. It never connected to the metallurgical thread or the Portuguese thread. It was decoration pretending to be personality. Replaced in spirit by debasement-hover, which does the same destabilizing work but from within the site's own logic.
